text: Attempt 10 ended bankrupt in Jan 2048 (peak 109,570, fastest to 100,000). Attempt 11 starts: same fast opening, but ordinances on from day one, a stricter loan limit, and no tax raises on a stalled city.
Feb 2001: loans 2-4; a20-2003, a19-2002 (coal + pumps), a19-2004 - attempt 10's opening
Tax controller: shops 7 -> 8 (demand 1873), factories 7 -> 8 (demand 2000)
Dec 2002: 9,820 people, ahead of attempt 10 (8,730 at the same date). Zoo built on time; ordinances on since day one.
Tax controller: homes 7 -> 6 (demand -1092), factories 8 -> 9 (demand 2000)
Dec 2003: loans 5-6; seaport + dense job strip (a19-2006, unemployment 9%, factory demand 1,769) and the NE airport (c4a6-airport)
Dec 2003: airport built (c4a6-airport, edge guard overridden as in attempt 10; landing checks on); the strips beyond it now have power
Feb 2004: east homes beside the seaport job strip (TRIPS weak) + power links (c4a6-east-homes, c4a7-east-power)
Jul 2004: south pumps + power (spare water 7%) - a19-pumps-s, c4a6-pumps-power
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 7 (demand -594)
Feb 2005: loans 7-8; stadium, fire stations, district 5 + power (factory land short: demand 1,914, 23 empty; 15,600 people at the recreation cap) - attempt 10 did this in 2007
Dec 2005: east coal plant + fire station (spare power 12%) - c4a6-coal-e, c4a6-coal-e-fire
Dec 2005: 18,350 people, about 3,000 ahead of attempt 10 at this date. 8 loans so far; building the east coal plant now (spare power 12%).
Dec 2006: loan 9; mid pumps (water 6%), west block + pipes, south district + power - attempt 10's Dec 2008 step
Dec 2006: loan 9 refused by the loan budget guard (2050 projection -$87k). Kept the rule: built the mid pumps from cash ($1,647), west block and south district wait until the guard allows a loan
Feb 2007: loan 9 (guard allowed after the January budget); west block + pipes, south district + power (factory land short: demand 2,000, 29 empty)
Tax controller: shops 7 -> 8 (demand 1630)
Dec 2007: loan 10; SE district (shops/homes) + pipe, road links (shop land short: demand 2,000, 28 empty)
Dec 2007: 26,020 people, about 5,700 ahead of attempt 10. 9 loans; the loan guard made me wait two months for loan 9. Next: south-east shops, then cross the river much earlier than attempt 10 (2016).
Dec 2007: south coal plant (spare power 17%), second seaport + join (factory demand 2,000) - from cash
Tax controller: homes 6 -> 7 (demand 586)

Feb 2008: cash fell ~$2,300 in 2007 (10 loans vs home tax 6%). Home demand +586 (growing, not stalled) -> home tax 7%, controller floor 7. River crossing waits until land runs short (219 empty home tiles) to save loans
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 9 (demand 2000)

Dec 2008: loan 11; lake pumps (water 11%), south band + south-west band (shop/factory land short). Loan floor: 3,000 per loan below 60,000 people, 4,000 above (a flat 4,000 would block every loan to ~44,000; attempt 6 ran ~3,000 until 50,000)

CONTROL: Jul 2009 I reused attempt 8's shore-pump plan without reading it - half of it is on the west bank (x31-35 y76), which has no power or pipes yet in this attempt (~$500 of pumps waiting). audit.py now takes run.json pending_pumps (WARN until their district is built; any other dark pump still FAILs). Rule: read a reused plan's comment for what it depends on
Dec 2009: loan 12; river crossing - west district with causeway (c4a8-west), west power, west coal plant (shop/factory land short, spare power 11%) - attempt 10 crossed in 2016
Dec 2009: 36,380 people, over 10,000 ahead of attempt 10. Crossing the river six years earlier than attempt 10, with loan 12.
Tax controller: homes 7 -> 8 (demand 1612)
Jul 2010: loan 13; west coal plant (spare power 4%), zoo #2 (home cap warning: 2 recreation buildings for 41,530)
Tax controller: homes 8 -> 9 (demand 1950)
Feb 2011: loan 14; west district 2 (homes/factories/shops + riverbank pumps) and west 3 (shop cells) - shop land short (11 empty)
Dec 2011: coal plant x67-70 y70-73 + fire station, line across road x76 to line x77 (spare power 9%) - c4a9-coal-2041, from cash
Dec 2011: 48,740 people (attempt 10 had ~31,000 here). 14 loans, ~3,500 people each. New coal plant from cash; next: more land on the west bank as the January budget allows.
Jun 2012: loan 15; SW strip x38-54 y72-97 (homes and factories alternating, c4a8-swind) - home land short (13 empty), cash -$1,124
Jun 2012: SW strip joined - swind-fix, road join across line y70, powerfix (22 line tiles); audit passes
Feb 2013: SW strip pipes (62 dry buildings); loan 16; SW home strip x8-48 y99-118 + power (home land short: 29 empty)
